name: Seared Verlasso Salmon & Honey Parsnip Purée
whyItWorks: Sustainably raised Verlasso salmon is buttery and rich in omega-3s, and the wild honey parsnip purée is whipped completely smooth.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If you have a strict citrus guardrail, ask to hold the orange-fennel essence reduction (serve plain with butter or olive oil) and skip the fibrous black garlic rapini stems.
